description: Time-stretches by repeating each 'wavecycle' multiplier times while morphing its shape (and length) step by step into the next wavecycle - waveshape interpolation, not spectral interpolation. The transformation is drastic and strongly granular. Duration model 'indur * multiplier' verified to within 0.35% on tone and noise inputs at multipliers 2-8 (assumes skipcycles is 0). Mono only.
musical_use: The smoother, stranger sibling of distort repeat: instead of stamping identical copies, successive wavecycles gliss and bend as they flow into one another, adding a modulatory, vocal quality to the stretch. Low multipliers (2-4) give a granular slow-down with audible internal glissandi; as multiplier rises the perception of separate grains increases and the apparent pitchiness grows - by 32 the sound becomes a strange stream of modulating tones. A time-varying multiplier (breakpoint file) gives accelerating/decelerating stretch.

multiplier.description: Number of times each wavecycle repeats while morphing into the next (integer; CDP-enforced range 2-32767 - the binary rejects 1 with 'Value (1.000000) out of range (2.000000 to 32767.000000)'). Output duration is roughly indur * multiplier, so large values on long files produce very long outputs (60 on a 2 s file gave 119.7 s). May vary over time (banner-confirmed; probe verified - a 2->8 breakpoint render differs from both endpoint scalar renders and lands at the envelope's mean stretch).

skipcycles.description: Number of wavecycles to skip at the start of the file (integer; CDP-enforced range 0-32767; internal default 0). Skipped material is dropped from the output entirely (verified: -s100 on a 440 Hz tone at multiplier 2 shortened the output by ~2 x 100/440 s), so nonzero values make the duration model over-predict. Scalar only - a breakpoint file is refused.

examples.expected_use: Granular octave-down-feeling slow-down with internal glissandi; output about twice the input length.
The source dissolves into a long, strange stream of gliding tones (output ~32x input length - keep the input short).

known_issues: BANNER BUG: the usage banner ends 'multiplier and cyclecnt may vary over time.' but distort interpolate has no cyclecnt parameter - the line is copy-pasted from distort repeat. Only multiplier is breakpoint-capable (verified); the HTML manual correctly says 'multiplier may vary over time'.

skipcycles drops the skipped wavecycles from the output rather than passing them through; the shortfall is content-dependent (cycles, not seconds) and cannot be modelled statically - excluded from the duration model.
skipcycles rejects breakpoint files: 'ERROR: Cannot read parameter 2 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.'
Mono only: a stereo input is refused with 'Application doesn't work with this type of infile.' (exit 255).
